result.brief: 提出 STATERA，用冻结 V-JEPA 视频骨干加轻量时序 tubelet 混合器，从单目短视频估计不透明刚体的隐藏质心，并给出 HiddenMass 基准与零样本 sim-to-real 迁移分析。
result.reason: Uses frozen V-JEPA video backbone with temporal tubelet mixer for physical property estimation from video, enabling physics-aware video representation relevant to world models.
